title: Original IBM Bob task-session screenshot evidence
provenance: Existing genuine IBM Bob IDE screen captures, retained byte-for-byte. Documentation and hashing are separate from the original images.
usagePolicy: Display values are transcribed per image. Intermediate and connection screenshots repeat task usage; no aggregate billing or remaining-credit amount is claimed.
claimLimits: A task-session usage summary is participation/provenance evidence, not a standalone successful-test report.
The Stage C budget-stop screenshot records an interrupted partial implementation.
The MCP connection screenshot proves registration and visible tool discovery, not a Bob tool invocation or source repair.
Historical prompts describe their capture-time state; later model integration and Codex work are documented separately.
Visual credential review is limited to visible screenshot contents.
